summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing from AXIA Energia S.A., a Brazilian electric utility, reporting the discontinuation of an existing publication and the transfer of operational data to a new Modeling Guide spreadsheet. The filing includes extensive tables of installed capacity and physical guarantee data by region and power plant, with no transaction, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, or other special situation event described. It is purely an informational update regarding reporting format changes, with no deal terms, board recommendations, or financial advisor involvement. No investor action or risk arbitrage angle exists.
